# WoWTopGear

> Official analytical suite, class guides, and Top Gear mathematical gear optimizer for **World of Warcraft: Midnight — Season 2 (Patch 12.1.5)**.

WoWTopGear is a client-side analytical suite designed for World of Warcraft players and automated AI agents. It executes real-time gear combinations, secondary stat diminishing returns (DR), and gem/enchant optimizations locally in browser memory with zero simulation queues.

- **Current WoW Expansion**: World of Warcraft: Midnight
- **Current Season**: Season 2 (Patch 12.1.5)
- **Supported Classes**: 13 (including Demon Hunter with 3 specs: Havoc, Vengeance, and Devourer)
- **Supported Specializations**: 40 total specs
- **Languages**: English (`en`) and Spanish (`es`)

## Core Pages & Tools

- [WoWTopGear Home Portal](https://wowtopgear.app/): Main portal with Midnight Season 2 Blue Tracker, official news reader, and ecosystem links.
- [Top Gear Calculator & SimC Optimizer](https://wowtopgear.app/gearsim): Real-time combinatorial gear optimizer, Great Vault analyzer, and secondary stat calculator.
- [Midnight Season 2 Class Guides Directory](https://wowtopgear.app/classes/): Complete directory of all 13 classes and 40 specialization guides.
- [XML Sitemap](https://wowtopgear.app/sitemap.xml): Complete index of all 56 canonical URLs.

## Official Midnight (Level 90) Secondary Stat Diminishing Returns (DR)

Base rating required for **1%** at Level 90 (before DR):
- **Haste**: `44` rating = `1%`
- **Critical Strike**: `46` rating = `1%`
- **Mastery**: `46` rating = `1 base Mastery point`
- **Versatility**: `54` rating = `1%` (+1% damage/healing, -0.5% damage taken)

| Secondary Stat | **0% DR (0–30%)** | **-10% DR (30–39%)** | **-20% DR (39–47%)** | **-30% DR (47–54%)** | **-40% DR (54–66%)** | **-50% DR (66–126%)** | **Hard Cap (>126%)** |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **Haste** | `0 – 1,320` | `1,320 – 1,760` | `1,760 – 2,200` | `2,200 – 2,640` | `2,640 – 3,080` | `3,080 – 8,800` | `> 8,800` |
| **Critical Strike** | `0 – 1,380` | `1,380 – 1,840` | `1,840 – 2,300` | `2,300 – 2,760` | `2,760 – 3,220` | `3,220 – 9,200` | `> 9,200` |
| **Mastery** | `0 – 1,380` | `1,380 – 1,840` | `1,840 – 2,300` | `2,300 – 2,760` | `2,760 – 3,220` | `3,220 – 9,200` | `> 9,200` |
| **Versatility** | `0 – 1,620` | `1,620 – 2,160` | `2,160 – 2,700` | `2,700 – 3,240` | `3,240 – 3,780` | `3,780 – 10,800` | `> 10,800` |

## Midnight Season 2 (Patch 12.1.5) Upgrade Tracks & Item Levels

- **Champion Track (1/6 to 6/6)**: `295` – `311` ilvl
- **Hero Track (1/6 to 6/6)**: `308` – `321` ilvl (Hero 6/6 + Venomstone `+10` = `331` ilvl)
- **Myth Track (1/6 to 6/6)**: `321` – `334` ilvl (Myth 6/6 + Venomstone `+10` = `344` ilvl)
- **Crafted Gear**: `318` ilvl (Hero tier) / `331` ilvl (Myth tier); with Venomstone `+10` = `328` / `341` ilvl.
